assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single premium game UI medal, usable at 48–72 pixels, for MercuryPitch / BesideCue Glassworks, a whimsical floating marble-and-glass museum vocal-learning game. Generate one centered front-facing circular singing medal on a genuinely transparent background, isolated with generous clean transparent margin. The medal is a beautiful small jewel: antique warm champagne-gold thin raised rim, translucent celadon/sea-glass enamel center, one bold sculpted golden musical quaver, tiny restrained pearl inset at the top. A few art nouveau curves engraved into the rim, but keep the central musical note very legible at tiny size. Polished handcrafted museum artifact with delicate realistic bevels and restrained highlights, no glitter cloud or external glow. Orthographic front view, symmetrical silhouette, crisp alpha edge. Palette deep teal, pale celadon, champagne gold; compatible with an ivory results card. No text, letters, grade, star count, ribbon tails, scenery, mockup, watermark, extra medals or drop shadow outside the object.
